enabled.description: Master switch. When off, no recall, no diary and no commands do anything.

auto_recall.description: Inject recalled titles into the LLM request for human messages.

retrieval.description: Recall strategy: auto (lexical when the self-learning build is present and BGE is absent), lexical, hybrid or granite (granite online fusion is not exposed; behaves like hybrid).

rsrs_bin.description: Absolute path to the rsrs binary. Empty means auto-discovery (config > $RSRS_BIN > ~/.local/bin/rsrs-dafeiyu > ~/.rsrs/bin/rsrs > PATH).

data_dir.description: Optional RSRS_DATA_DIR for the child process. Empty uses the CLI default.

rpc_port.description: RSRS_RPC_PORT for the child process when data_dir is set (0 keeps the machine default). A non-default data dir must not share the single 15169 runtime, or writes silently land in the real library.

recall_limit.description: Maximum recalled titles per injection; 20 matches the respire hook title depth.

recall_budget_chars.description: Hard character budget for the injected recall block.

recall_excerpt_chars.description: Verbatim head excerpt in characters for the top recalled record; 0 disables the extra show call and injects titles only.

recall_timeout_ms.description: Recall timeout in milliseconds; the child is killed on timeout and the turn continues without memory.

cooldown_ms.description: Per-conversation minimum gap between two recall injections.

same_query_cooldown_ms.description: Minimum gap before the same query may be recalled again in one conversation.

min_score_hybrid.description: Cosine floor for hybrid recall items. Lexical (BM25) scores are never floor-filtered.

scope_mode.description: per_conversation (default: one scope per group or private chat), per_user (private and group share the user scope — private facts may surface in groups), or global (one scope for every chat).

admin_ids.description: Raw QQ user ids allowed to reveal bodies in groups and to run admin commands. Kept only in AstrBot config, never written to memory.

auto_diary.description: Store a short raw-continuity diary row after each answered turn.

auto_diary_group.description: Also store diary rows for group chats. Off by default: group chatter is noisy.

proactive.description: Optional unverified reflection injection (default off: it can disrupt group chat).

permission_turns.description: Reflection injections allowed per permission window.

reflection_ttl_days.description: Validity of stored reflections in days.

selfnote.description: Self-note: a small, versioned block inside the bot persona. The base rules outside the managed markers are never rewritten. `enabled` only gates the memory_selfnote LLM tool; the explicit /mem_selfnote commands always work so an admin can inspect or repair the block.

enabled.description: Allow the memory_selfnote LLM tool to rewrite the block. Manual /mem_selfnote commands are not gated by this switch.

auto_enabled.description: Low-frequency automatic self-note refresh (default off). Only real replies in the owner's private chat count; a group chat, another user, a command turn or a secret turn never counts. When the count reaches every_sessions and at least min_interval_ms has passed since the last automatic attempt, the existing generate+apply path runs once in the background. A failed attempt retries no sooner than retry_backoff_ms.

every_sessions.description: Real private-owner replies required before an automatic refresh is attempted; clamped to 5-100.

min_interval_ms.description: Minimum time between two automatic refresh attempts in milliseconds; at least 3600000 (1 hour), default 604800000 (7 days).

retry_backoff_ms.description: After a failed automatic attempt, wait this long before trying again, in milliseconds; at least 600000 (10 minutes), default 21600000 (6 hours).

persona_id.description: AstrBot persona id whose system_prompt carries the managed block.

owner_id.description: Raw QQ id whose private scope supplies evidence titles. Empty falls back to the first admin_ids entry. Kept only in AstrBot config, never written to memory.

parent_id.description: Optional real rsrs id used as the causal parent of each self-note version. Needed for an important self-note when metadata v1 is off; also used when it is on. Empty means no parent and legacy mode stores a trivial record.

provider_id.description: Chat provider id for generation. Empty uses the host's current provider.

evidence_limit.description: Maximum recalled evidence titles sent to the generator; clamped to 1-20.

max_full_chars.description: Stored preference for the full self-note cap; hard cap is 1200.

max_brief_chars.description: Stored preference for the persona block cap; hard cap is 300.

jobs.description: Self-learning schedule. Training/encoder are off by default because the DSH plugin may already own them. The nightly maintenance pass is read-only (rsrs audit + review --due): it never deletes, updates or forgets a memory and runs even when jobs.enabled is false.

enabled.description: Run the daily training and weekly encoder schedule. Independent of maintenance_enabled.

maintenance_enabled.description: Run the nightly read-only maintenance (rsrs audit --json and rsrs review --due --json). It only reads counters, never deletes, updates or forgets a memory, and it runs even when jobs.enabled is false.

maintenance_hour.description: Local hour of the nightly read-only maintenance run.

maintenance_minute.description: Local minute of the nightly read-only maintenance run.

review_limit.description: Due reviews requested by the maintenance pass and /mem_review; clamped to 1-100.

daily_hour.description: Local hour of the daily learn train run.

daily_minute.description: Local minute of the daily learn train run.

daily_limit.description: Label cap passed to learn train.

weekly_granite.description: Run the weekly Granite encoder script on Sunday 02:00 when it is installed.

anchor_dir.description: Encoder state and index anchor directory.

debug_log.description: Write plugin debug lines to <state>/logs/dafeiyu.log. Memory text is never logged.
